import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        PriorityQueue<Integer> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = scanner.nextInt();
            pq.add(x);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
            pq.poll();
        }
        System.out.println(pq.peek());
    }
}
